title: Topic 6
japanese_text:
A：いろいろな人が言ってるけど、アニメは<u>映像</u>の美しさよりも<u>脚本</u>の方が大事だよね。ストーリーに<u>共感できない</u>と意味がないから。
B：映像も、単純な美しさよりも、ストーリーやキャラクターの感情に<u>マッチした</u> <u>演出</u>になっているかが大事だね。
english_translation: A: Many people say that for animation, the script is more important than the beauty of the images. If you can't relate to the story, it's meaningless. B: For the images too, rather than simply being beautiful, it's more important that their direction matches the story and the emotions of the characters.
